response_texts: Strange... It is so strange. This one feels like he is supposed to be here and yet he is nowhere to be found.
Ja'zel wonders who it is in someone else's dream... Who in Oblivion dreams of the dreaming gods, dreaming of Ja'zel?
Ja'zel, Ja'zeri, the hidden survivors of Saarthal, Orlando of Atmora, Ja'bal the Cat, and Laza the Shepherd... no, it is even earlier.
Lamae... No, her death is a fixed point, it must be. But from where? How did Laza survive on his own? Who was watching? Who passed on the knowledge, hmm?
Was Molag Bal not the only one who was there, perhaps? Something unnatural is interfering. Hmm... Where did it come from?
A haze is hanging over everything... There is someone without a name, yes? It is not Sheggorath, and yet it feels as if he was there all along...
Did they take away the name Yffre gave it or did they simply make them forget? Who knew... No, it is obvious...
Where does the water in the river come from? From the spring to the sea, from the beginning to the end... The Blue Star is visible now. But that is not Ja'zel's role to play.
Ja'zel can only ever be Ja'zel. Only Ja'zel can weave the tale of Ja'zel. And Ja'zel's tale comes to an end here.
It is no longer Ja'zel's from this point on. It is the tale of the one who watches Ja'zel now. It is the tale of Ja'zel's dear little Chick...
Ysmir's Howl... That region moved from Solitude to Thalmor hands after the war. What's its current status?
Initially, they intended to gradually convert Talos worshippers in the city under the moderate Justiciar Varano.
But two years ago Justiciar Varano fell to the epidemic and Eton Nir Research Institute took over the Temple City.
An epidemic... There's been no information from the city since then. What does the Eton Nir Tech have to say about this?
Their head researcher reported that Varano died and the entire city population got wiped out by the epidemic.
Indeed, it's a tactic they often use. Was there no response from Solitude or the Empire at the time?
Solitude was suspicious and sent scouts several times, but they all went missing.
So, an epidemic, missing scouts, and an increase in beast possession, all at the same time. I have a bad feeling about this.
With good reason. Something similar happened when non-elvish settlements disappeared in Alinor.
Truly, we live in rotten times. Though, Witch Hunters like us really shouldn't say that...
This is Alfilion, the Chief of Skyrim's branch of Eton Nir Research Institute, right? Tell us more about him.
From his activities in Alinor Youth, he later moved on to an assassination unit. He was also present at the siege of Cloud Ruler Temple.
He retired after he was injured by one of the last Blade members. After that, he moved to Eton Nir Research Institute, where he is currently the chief of Skyrim branch.
When it comes to Alinor Youth, they seem like serious elf supremacists. A career worthy of a Thalmor, really.
He also has a hobby of making masks from the skulls of his victims. There's a bizarre side to his character, it seems.
An insane hobby. Well, it doesn't matter. So, Romion, is he a serious obstacle to our mission?
Well, he was injured enough to retire, but with the help of Dwemer technology he regained his previous fighting capabilities.
You should avoid fighting him if you can. And be wary of attacks from blind spots - he's still a master assassin.
This time we're collecting a "key"... Do we have any more information on its shape or material?
A "Bronze Key" in possession of Eton Nir Research Institute. That's Thalmor jargon. We're talking about a person here, not an actual key.
So who is the Eton Nir Research Institute hiding?
An Altmer mage Arkved. A Thalmor spy recovered his body from Cyrodiil in the Third Era.
Is Arkved dead, then? Are the Thalmor studying necromancy on his corpse?
It seems they're using it for research related to Vaermina, but I don't know any more details at the moment.
More bloodstains. And traces of something being dragged. Let's follow this.
O little louse. You still have a song to sing, don't you? Myrrh smells bitter.
It is foolish to stretch yourself on the grave. So turn back. It is only a single night's moment
Did you find out where Felix is?
No, not yet. But he certainly stayed in Falkreath. Khajiit needs more time.
Hurry up, he doesn't have much time left.
Khajiit does not want to say such a thing, but it is already too late. Your friend's memory is already too far gone.
But he will tell you when he finds your old friend. You would want to put him out of his misery yourself, no?
Thank you...
No worries, this is a part of Ja'zel's job, also.
There's dried meat inside and there are some scratches on the barrels. Looks like they were made by claws...
The goal of our mission is this "baby"... Do we have any more information about it?
Almost nothing. Considering it's the source of the ghouls, it could be a type of curse...
Its curse probably spreads indiscriminately to its surroundings... Even approaching it will be dangerous. The Chick Trader will recover it, right?
That is the plan, but how is he going to do it?
Gods only know. We don't really need to know that...
It feels good when I'm taking care of Lalanoah. What could I even say... it's heartwarming.
I keep asking myself if I'll ever feel like that once I have a family of my own.
It's really strange. It makes me so happy when she laughs... I've never felt like this in my life.
I guess that's why I love Lalanoah so much. It's as if she was my own child...
There's nothing... Nothing! Nothing! No... Nothing!
What in Oblivion... is that a skooma addict? I have a bad feeling... Lalanoah, go home, right now.
What? But I...
Ah, it's there! Hah! Found it! So good! Want it!
Get out of here, Lalanoah!
What do I want? What do I want? Nothing! No, nothing!
This guy is a bloody menace... We don't have a choice.
All right, here we are. This is where the big bird used to live a while ago.
Yes, I know. Uncle Brandt and our friend beat it!
It wasn't anything special. It was just a giant chicken against us.
Awesome! I wanted to fight it, too! Count me in next time!
When you're a little bigger.
Yes, that's good. Now, close your eyes.
Hey, Lalanoah... Our friend is here. And there may be someone who can fix your music box...
Really? My music box will be repaired?
Yeah, maybe. Please, come out of your room.
...Well, if it's just maybe, I'm never coming out! I'm staying in here forever!
Lalanoah, don't you even want to see your friend?
Erm... I can't be with you right now. Can you just stay here for a while?
But then your friend can't take the music box to be repaired, right? Why don't you come out for just a minute?
That's enough! Leave me alone! Please, everyone, just go away!
Hey, can you see me? Are you two all right?
We're fine. We defeated the oneireomancer, too. So what do we do now?
I'd like you to retrieve the Oneiromancer's memories now. The terminal should be nearby - just follow my instructions.
I'll handle all the details, so your task is simple. Ozwald, please stand in front of the control panel...
I need you to work on the central terminal to extract the memories.
I'm not very good at dealing with machines, but I guess I'll have to do... But why is that Dwemer machine even here?
Apparently, the Dwemer were trying to settle Quagmire. This must be one of the vanguard ships from that time.
How dare they mess with the world of dreams! No wonder they got themselves wiped out...
Hamah was a Daughter of Kyne. I met her in Vahdin Holt, in the boundary forest which supposedly follows Kyne's teachings...
We fell in love and swore ourselves to each other. But the priests opposed us. I was banished from the forest and Hamah was imprisoned.
We met again in exile, years later. Hamah left her homeland and came to visit me. She was injured, and bloody... and pregnant.
She said the child was mine. I decided to believe her... I couldn't do anything else.
The child was a girl. When she grew up, she grew into a perfect likeness of her mother. Even so... I have no regrets.
In order to connect people with Kyne, the priestesses were unable to bear their own children. Still, I trust Hamah and her daughters...
I loved Hamah and so, I can't help but love her daughters, too...
There are a lot of letters addressed to Falkreath. They belong to the courier that was supposed to come today, no doubt.
